name: Topotecan (relapsed/subsequent SCLC)

source.nccn: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Cell Lung Cancer
source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: Not biomarker-gated. Single-agent topotecan is a preferred subsequent (second-line and beyond) therapy option after prior platinum-based SCLC treatment. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Small Cell Lung Cancer v1.2027, SCLC Subsequent Systemic Therapy (SCL-E 3 of 6).

histology: small cell lung cancer (small cell carcinoma; high-grade neuroendocrine)

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: topotecan antiemetic prophylaxis per guideline tier.

supportiveCare: Consider dose reduction or growth-factor support for PS 2 patients. Source: SCLC v1.2027, SCL-E 3 of 6, line 1031.

Fatigue and hematologic toxicities are substantial with topotecan, particularly at the recommended schedule (DeVita 12th ed. line 73900); monitor counts and reduce dose or add growth-factor support per clinical review.

Oral and IV topotecan are similar in activity and tolerability (DeVita 12th ed. lines 19448 to 19451), so either route may be used per the guideline (SCL-E 3 of 6); the encoded oral dose 2.3 mg/m2/day for 5 days is grounded, while the IV 1.5 mg/m2/day for 5 days every 21 days value is printed only in non-SCLC contexts in the corpus (DeVita lines 180065 and 175882).
monitoring: CBC before and during each cycle (topotecan is markedly myelosuppressive: neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, anemia)
renal function (topotecan is renally cleared; dose-adjust for renal impairment)

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 3 to 4 myelosuppression (neutropenia/thrombocytopenia) or renal impairment
doseModificationRules.text: Reduce dose, delay, or add growth-factor support per clinical review; fatigue and hematologic toxicities are substantial with topotecan (DeVita 12th ed. line 73900). Renal dose adjustment required.

drugs.name: Topotecan
drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed. lines 19448 to 19451 (Oral topotecan 2.3 mg/m2/day orally once daily for 5 consecutive days, repeated every 21 days; activity and tolerability similar to the IV formulation in small cell lung cancer patients). This is the SCLC-explicit grounded dose. Alternative route: IV topotecan 1.5 mg/m2/day for 5 days every 21 days is the conventional intravenous second-line SCLC dose; in the provided corpus that 1.5 mg/m2 for 5 days every 21 days value is printed only in non-SCLC contexts (DeVita line 180065, ovarian PLD registration trial; DeVita line 175882, regimen table), so its numeric value is grounded to those non-SCLC entries rather than an SCLC-specific line. Fatigue and hematologic toxicities are substantial with topotecan, particularly at the recommended schedule (DeVita line 73900); topotecan is markedly myelosuppressive and renally cleared, so monitor counts and renal function and dose-adjust accordingly.

provenance.locator: lines 19448 to 19451 (Oral topotecan 2.3 mg/m2/day orally once daily for 5 consecutive days repeated every 21 days; activity and tolerability similar to the IV formulation in small cell lung cancer patients)
